concepts.name: Natural, whole and integer numbers
concepts.definition_en: Natural numbers are the counting numbers 1, 2, 3, ...; whole numbers add 0 to them; integers add the negatives of natural numbers, so integers are ..., -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, ...
concepts.explanation_hi: Ginti wale numbers natural hain, unme 0 milao to whole, aur minus wale milao to integers ban jaate hain.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Rational and irrational numbers
concepts.definition_en: A rational number can be written as p/q where p and q are integers and q is not zero; an irrational number cannot be written in that form and has a non-terminating, non-repeating decimal expansion.
concepts.explanation_hi: Jo number p/q form me likha ja sake woh rational hai, aur jiska decimal kabhi khatam na ho aur repeat na ho woh irrational hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Prime and composite numbers
concepts.definition_en: A prime number has exactly two factors, 1 and itself; a composite number has more than two factors. The number 1 is neither prime nor composite.
concepts.explanation_hi: Prime ke sirf do bhag hote hain, 1 aur woh khud; composite ke do se zyada bhag hote hain, aur 1 na prime hai na composite.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Consecutive-number sums
concepts.definition_en: The sum of the first n natural numbers is n(n+1)/2, and the sums of consecutive even or odd numbers follow the same pairing idea, giving a direct formula instead of adding term by term.
concepts.explanation_hi: Lagatar numbers ka jod ek-ek karke mat jodo, formula se seedha nikalo, jaise pehle n numbers ka jod n(n+1)/2 hota hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Divisibility by 2 to 11
concepts.definition_en: Divisibility rules are short tests for whether a number divides exactly by another: for example, a number is divisible by 2 if its last digit is even, by 3 if its digit sum is a multiple of 3, by 5 if it ends in 0 or 5, and by 11 if the difference of the sums of alternate digits is 0 or a multiple of 11.
concepts.explanation_hi: Bina poora bhag diye check karo ki number divide hoga ya nahi, jaise aakhri digit dekh kar 2 aur 5 ka test hota hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Remainder on division
concepts.definition_en: When a number is divided by a divisor, the remainder is what is left over after the largest whole multiple of the divisor is subtracted; the remainder is always smaller than the divisor.
concepts.explanation_hi: Bhag dene ke baad jo bach jaata hai woh remainder hai, aur woh hamesha divisor se chhota hota hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Remainder of powers
concepts.definition_en: The remainder of a power a^n on division by d can be found by replacing a with its remainder on division by d and working with the smaller numbers, using the fact that remainders multiply in the same way as the numbers themselves.
concepts.explanation_hi: Badi power ka remainder nikalne ke liye base ka remainder le lo aur chhote numbers se kaam karo, poori power nikalne ki zaroorat nahi.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Cyclicity of unit digits
concepts.definition_en: The unit digit of powers of a number repeats in a fixed cycle: for example, powers of 2 cycle through 2, 4, 8, 6, so the unit digit of a large power is found from the position of the exponent within the cycle.
concepts.explanation_hi: Power badhne par unit digit ek fixed cycle me ghoomta hai, jaise 2 ki powers me 2, 4, 8, 6 repeat hote hain.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Trailing zeroes in factorials
concepts.definition_en: The number of trailing zeroes in n! equals the number of times the factor 5 occurs in the numbers from 1 to n, counted as the sum of the quotients n/5 + n/25 + n/125 and so on until the quotient becomes zero.
concepts.explanation_hi: Factorial ke aakhir me kitne zero honge, yeh 5 ke factors gin kar pata chalta hai, kyunki har zero ke liye ek 2 aur ek 5 chahiye.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Fraction comparison without HCF/LCM
concepts.definition_en: Two fractions can be compared without finding a common denominator by cross-multiplying: for positive fractions a/b and c/d, a/b is greater than c/d exactly when a x d is greater than b x c.
concepts.explanation_hi: Do fractions ko compare karne ke liye cross-multiply karo, bada product wali fraction badi hoti hai, LCM nikalne ki zaroorat nahi.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Recurring decimals
concepts.definition_en: A recurring decimal has a digit or block of digits that repeats forever; it can be converted to a fraction by subtracting the non-repeating part, which removes the repeating block and leaves a terminating equation to solve.
concepts.explanation_hi: Jo decimal baar-baar repeat hota hai use fraction me badla ja sakta hai, repeat wale hisse ko ghata kar equation banao aur solve karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Number of factors
concepts.definition_en: If a number has prime factorisation p^a x q^b x ..., the total number of its factors is (a+1)(b+1)..., because each prime's exponent in a factor can be chosen from 0 up to its exponent in the number.
concepts.explanation_hi: Kitne bhag honge yeh prime factorisation se nikalta hai, har prime ke power me 1 jod kar sabko guna karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Sum of divisors
concepts.definition_en: If a number has prime factorisation p^a x q^b x ..., the sum of all its divisors is the product over each prime of (p^(a+1) - 1)/(p - 1), which is the sum 1 + p + p^2 + ... + p^a for that prime multiplied across primes.
concepts.explanation_hi: Sabhi bhagon ka jod nikalne ke liye har prime ke liye 1 se lekar uski power tak ka jod lo aur phir sabko guna karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Smallest and largest number formation
concepts.definition_en: The smallest number from a given set of digits is formed by arranging the digits in ascending order with care that zero does not lead, and the largest by arranging them in descending order, using place value so that larger digits in higher places give a larger number.
concepts.explanation_hi: Diye gaye digits se sabse chhota number banane ke liye chhote digit aage rakho (zero sabse aage nahi) aur sabse bada banane ke liye bade digit aage rakho.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: HCF and LCM by prime factorisation
concepts.definition_en: The HCF of two or more numbers is the product of their common prime factors raised to the smallest exponent, and the LCM is the product of all their prime factors raised to the largest exponent.
concepts.explanation_hi: Prime factorisation se HCF me common primes ki chhoti power lo aur LCM me sab primes ki badi power lo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: HCF and LCM by division method
concepts.definition_en: In the division method, numbers are divided repeatedly by common prime divisors until no common divisor remains; the product of the divisors gives the HCF, and for LCM the division continues with the remaining quotients and the product of all divisors and quotients gives the LCM.
concepts.explanation_hi: Division method me common primes se baar-baar bhag do, divisors ka guna HCF deta hai aur divisors aur quotients ka guna LCM deta hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: HCF and LCM of fractions
concepts.definition_en: The HCF of fractions is the HCF of their numerators divided by the LCM of their denominators, and the LCM of fractions is the LCM of their numerators divided by the HCF of their denominators.
concepts.explanation_hi: Fractions ka HCF nikalne ke liye numerator ka HCF aur denominator ka LCM lo, aur LCM ke liye ulta karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Largest number dividing x, y, z leaving remainders
concepts.definition_en: The largest number that divides x, y and z leaving remainders r1, r2 and r3 is the HCF of (x - r1), (y - r2) and (z - r3), because subtracting each remainder leaves numbers exactly divisible by the required number.
concepts.explanation_hi: Remainder chhod kar bhag dene wala sabse bada number nikalne ke liye har number se uska remainder ghata do aur phir HCF lo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Smallest number divisible leaving remainders
concepts.definition_en: The smallest number that leaves the same remainder r on division by each of several numbers is the LCM of those numbers plus r; when the remainders differ, the number is found from the LCM adjusted by the constant difference between each divisor and its remainder.
concepts.explanation_hi: Sabhi numbers se ek hi remainder chhodne wala sabse chhota number LCM me remainder jod kar milta hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Bells ringing together
concepts.definition_en: If bells ring at fixed intervals, they next ring together after a time equal to the LCM of their intervals, because the LCM is the first time that is a multiple of every interval.
concepts.explanation_hi: Ghantiyan dobara ek saath tab bajengi jab unke intervals ka LCM wala samay poora hoga.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Greatest size of tile
concepts.definition_en: The greatest square tile that can exactly cover a rectangular floor without cutting is a square whose side equals the HCF of the floor's length and breadth, because the tile side must divide both dimensions.
concepts.explanation_hi: Bina kaate farsh par lagne wali sabse badi square tile ki side lambaai aur chaudaai ka HCF hoti hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: BODMAS and VBODMAS order
concepts.definition_en: BODMAS gives the order of operations: Brackets, Of (powers of), Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction, with division and multiplication, and addition and subtraction, taken from left to right when they appear together.
concepts.explanation_hi: BODMAS ka matlab hai pehle bracket, phir of, phir bhag-guna, phir jod-ghata, isi order me solve karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Bar brackets
concepts.definition_en: A bar bracket (vinculum) over an expression means that expression is grouped together and must be simplified first, before the ordinary brackets around it, which is why VBODMAS puts the bar (V) before Brackets.
concepts.explanation_hi: Bar bracket ka matlab hai uske neeche wale hisse ko sabse pehle solve karo, phir baaki brackets kholo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Simplification of nested fractions
concepts.definition_en: A nested fraction is simplified by working from the innermost fraction or bracket outward, applying BODMAS at each level, so that each inner fraction is reduced to a single value before it is used in the outer fraction.
concepts.explanation_hi: Nested fraction me sabse andar wale hisse se shuru karo aur bahar ki taraf aate hue har level ko BODMAS se solve karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Surds and rationalisation
concepts.definition_en: A surd is an irrational root such as square root of 2 that cannot be simplified to a rational number; rationalisation removes a surd from the denominator by multiplying numerator and denominator by the conjugate surd, using the identity (a + root b)(a - root b) = a^2 - b.
concepts.explanation_hi: Surd woh root hai jo poora nahi nikalta, jaise root 2, aur denominator se use hatane ke liye conjugate se guna karte hain.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Indices and power rules
concepts.definition_en: Indices follow the power rules: multiplying powers with the same base adds the exponents, dividing subtracts them, a power raised to a power multiplies the exponents, and any non-zero number raised to 0 equals 1.
concepts.explanation_hi: Same base wali powers ko guna karne par power jud jaati hai, bhag karne par ghat jaati hai, aur kisi bhi number ki power 0 ka matlab 1 hota hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Negative and fractional exponents
concepts.definition_en: A negative exponent means the reciprocal, so a^(-n) = 1/a^n, and a fractional exponent means a root, so a^(1/n) is the nth root of a and a^(m/n) is the nth root of a^m.
concepts.explanation_hi: Minus power ka matlab ulta (reciprocal) hota hai aur fraction wali power ka matlab root hota hai, jaise a^(1/2) ka matlab root a hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Square and cube roots
concepts.definition_en: The square root of a number is a value that multiplied by itself gives the number, and the cube root is a value that multiplied by itself three times gives the number; square roots of perfect squares and cube roots of perfect cubes are whole numbers.
concepts.explanation_hi: Square root woh number hai jise khud se guna karne par wahi number mile, aur cube root teen baar guna karne par mile.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Approximate value
concepts.definition_en: An approximate value is found by rounding the numbers in an expression to nearby easy values, such as the nearest whole number or ten, and then computing with the rounded numbers, which gives an answer close to the exact value but not exact.
concepts.explanation_hi: Approximate value ke liye numbers ko paas ke aasan number par round kar lo aur phir solve karo, jawab exact nahi par kaafi kareeb hoga.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Percentage to fraction conversion
concepts.definition_en: A percentage is a fraction out of 100, so x% equals x/100, and common percentages convert to simple fractions, such as 50% = 1/2, 25% = 1/4 and 12.5% = 1/8, which makes percentage calculations faster.
concepts.explanation_hi: Percent matlab prati sau hota hai, isliye x% ka matlab x/100 hai, aur 50% seedha 1/2 ban jaata hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Percentage of a percentage
concepts.definition_en: To find x% of y% of a quantity, both percentages are applied in turn as multiplications by x/100 and y/100, so the result is the quantity multiplied by xy/10000.
concepts.explanation_hi: Kisi percentage ka percentage nikalne ke liye dono ko ek-ek karke lagao, jaise 10% ka 50% matlab 5% hota hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Election and vote share
concepts.definition_en: In an election problem, each candidate's votes are a percentage share of the total valid votes, and the winning margin is the difference between the winner's and loser's shares, so an unknown total can be found from a known margin and the percentage-point difference.
concepts.explanation_hi: Election me har candidate ke vote total valid votes ka ek percentage hote hain, aur jeet ka antar percentage points ke antar se total votes nikalne me madad karta hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Percentage increase and decrease
concepts.definition_en: A percentage increase or decrease expresses a change relative to the original value: percentage change equals the change divided by the original value multiplied by 100, and the new value equals the original multiplied by (100 plus or minus the percentage) over 100.
concepts.explanation_hi: Percent badhotri ya kami hamesha asli value ke hisaab se nikalti hai, change ko original se bhag dekar 100 se guna karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Successive percentage change and net effect
concepts.definition_en: When two percentage changes of x% and y% apply in succession, the net change is not x + y but x + y + xy/100 percent, because the second change applies to the already-changed value, with a minus sign used for decreases.
concepts.explanation_hi: Do baar percent change lagne par seedha jodna galat hai, dusra change badli hui value par lagta hai, isliye net effect me xy/100 wala hissa bhi aata hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Population growth and decay
concepts.definition_en: If a population grows or decays by a fixed percentage r each year, its value after n years is the present value multiplied by (1 plus or minus r/100) raised to n, which is repeated percentage change applied year after year.
concepts.explanation_hi: Har saal ek fixed percent se badhne ya ghatne wali population n saal baad present value ko (1 plus ya minus r/100) ki power n se guna karke milti hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Pass marks and failed students
concepts.definition_en: In pass-marks problems, the pass mark equals a student's marks plus the marks by which they failed, or minus the marks by which they passed, and the total maximum marks follow from the pass percentage applied to that pass mark.
concepts.explanation_hi: Pass marks nikalne ke liye fail hue student ke marks me uski kami jod do, ya pass hue ke marks me se uski zyada marks ghata do.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Income, expenditure and savings
concepts.definition_en: Savings equal income minus expenditure, and each of income, expenditure and savings can be expressed as a percentage of another, so a change in one with the others held fixed is found by working with the income-expenditure-savings equation.
concepts.explanation_hi: Bachat ka matlab aay me se kharch ghata dena hai, aur teeno ka rishta ek equation se judta hai jisse koi ek badle to dusra nikal sakta hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Simplifying ratios
concepts.definition_en: A ratio a:b is simplified by dividing both terms by their HCF, just like simplifying a fraction, so that the ratio is expressed in its lowest terms without changing the comparison it expresses.
concepts.explanation_hi: Ratio ko saral banane ke liye dono hisson ko unke HCF se bhag do, jaise fraction ko saral karte hain.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Compounded ratio
concepts.definition_en: The compounded ratio of a:b and c:d is ac:bd, obtained by multiplying the corresponding terms, which combines two separate comparisons into one ratio.
concepts.explanation_hi: Do ratios ko milakar ek ratio banane ke liye aage wale hisse aapas me aur peeche wale hisse aapas me guna karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Dividing a sum in a ratio
concepts.definition_en: To divide a sum S in the ratio a:b, the total parts are a + b, each part is worth S/(a + b), and the shares are a parts and b parts of that unit value.
concepts.explanation_hi: Kisi rakam ko ratio me baantne ke liye pehle kul hisse jodo, phir ek hisse ki keemat nikalo aur har share ko usse guna karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Income-expenditure ratio
concepts.definition_en: When incomes or expenditures of two people are given in a ratio and their savings are known, the actual amounts are found by letting the ratio terms be multiplied by a common factor and solving with the savings equation income minus expenditure equals savings.
concepts.explanation_hi: Aay aur kharch ke ratio se asli rakam nikalne ke liye ratio me ek common factor maan lo aur bachat wali equation se use solve karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Mean proportional
concepts.definition_en: The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is the number x such that a:x = x:b, which gives x equal to the square root of ab.
concepts.explanation_hi: Do numbers ke beech ka mean proportional woh number hai jo dono ke saath ek hi ratio banata hai, aur woh dono ke guna ka square root hota hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Third and fourth proportional
concepts.definition_en: The third proportional to a and b is x such that a:b = b:x, giving x = b^2/a, and the fourth proportional to a, b and c is x such that a:b = c:x, giving x = bc/a.
concepts.explanation_hi: Third proportional me pehle do numbers ka ratio dusre aur teesre ke ratio ke barabar hota hai, aur fourth me teen diye numbers se chautha isi tarah nikalta hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Partnership profit sharing by capital and time
concepts.definition_en: In a partnership, profit is shared in the ratio of each partner's capital multiplied by the time it stayed invested, so the shares follow the ratio (capital1 x time1) : (capital2 x time2).
concepts.explanation_hi: Partnership me munafa capital aur samay ke guna ke ratio me bantta hai, jiska paisa zyada der laga woh zyada hissa paata hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Direct proportion
concepts.definition_en: Two quantities are in direct proportion when an increase in one causes a proportional increase in the other, so their ratio stays constant and y = kx for some constant k.
concepts.explanation_hi: Direct proportion me ek cheez badhe to dusri bhi usi ratio me badhti hai, jaise zyada kaam zyada mazdoori deta hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Inverse proportion
concepts.definition_en: Two quantities are in inverse proportion when an increase in one causes a proportional decrease in the other, so their product stays constant and y = k/x for some constant k.
concepts.explanation_hi: Inverse proportion me ek cheez badhe to dusri usi ratio me ghat jaati hai, jaise zyada mazdoor kaam jaldi khatam karte hain.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Weighted mean price of a mixture
concepts.definition_en: The mean price of a mixture is the total cost of all its parts divided by the total quantity, which is the weighted average of the component prices with quantities as weights.
concepts.explanation_hi: Mishran ki ausat keemat nikalne ke liye sabhi hisson ki kul keemat ko kul matra se bhag do.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Ratio of two mixtures
concepts.definition_en: When two mixtures with known ingredient ratios are combined, the ratio in the final mixture is found by converting each mixture's ratio to the amount of each ingredient per unit, adding across mixtures in proportion to the quantities mixed, and simplifying the result.
concepts.explanation_hi: Do mishran milane par aakhri ratio nikalne ke liye har mishran se har cheez ki matra nikalo, phir jodo aur saral karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Alligation rule (cross method)
concepts.definition_en: The alligation rule finds the ratio in which two ingredients at prices c1 and c2 must be mixed to get a mean price m: the ratio is (m - c2) : (c1 - m) in absolute terms, read off the cross diagram where the mean price sits between the two prices.
concepts.explanation_hi: Alligation ka cross method batata hai ki kis ratio me do cheezein milao taaki beech wali ausat keemat mile, antar ko cross me likh kar ratio padho.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Replacement of a part of a mixture
concepts.definition_en: When a part of a mixture is removed and replaced by a pure ingredient, the quantities of the original ingredients fall in proportion to the part removed, and repeated replacement multiplies the remaining fraction each time, so after n replacements the original ingredient left is its starting quantity times (1 - replaced fraction)^n.
concepts.explanation_hi: Mishran ka ek hissa nikal kar shuddh cheez milane par baaki cheezein usi ratio me ghat jaati hain, aur baar-baar aisa karne par bacha hua hissa har baar guna hota jaata hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD; Selection Post: level-dependent (Graduation level only) (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Milk-water ratio change
concepts.definition_en: A milk-water ratio changes when milk or water is added or removed: the added quantity changes only its own component, so the new ratio is found by adding the change to that component and simplifying, keeping the other component fixed.
concepts.explanation_hi: Doodh-paani ke ratio me jab ek cheez milao ya nikalo to sirf wahi hissa badalta hai, dusra wahi rehta hai, phir naya ratio saral karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Alloy mixing
concepts.definition_en: Alloy mixing applies the same mixture idea to metals: when alloys with known metal ratios are melted together, each metal's total quantity is the sum of its quantities from each alloy, and the final alloy's ratio is the simplified ratio of those totals.
concepts.explanation_hi: Alloy milane par har dhatu ki kul matra alag-alag jod lo, phir unka ratio saral karne par nayi alloy ka ratio mil jaata hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Average of numbers
concepts.definition_en: The average of a set of numbers is their sum divided by how many numbers there are, and the sum can always be recovered as average multiplied by the count.
concepts.explanation_hi: Ausat ka matlab sab numbers ka jod unki ginti se bhag dena hai, aur jod wapas chahiye to ausat ko ginti se guna karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Cricket and batting average
concepts.definition_en: A batsman's batting average is total runs scored divided by the number of times dismissed, because not-out innings are excluded from the count, which is why an average can change sharply with one more innings.
concepts.explanation_hi: Batting average me kul runs ko out hone ki baar se bhag dete hain, not-out wali innings ginti me nahi aati.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Weighted average
concepts.definition_en: A weighted average gives different observations different weights, and equals the sum of each observation multiplied by its weight divided by the sum of the weights.
concepts.explanation_hi: Weighted average me har number ki apni keemat (weight) hoti hai, har ko uske weight se guna kar ke jodo aur kul weight se bhag do.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Average of groups combined
concepts.definition_en: The combined average of two groups is not the simple mean of their averages unless the groups are equal in size; it is the weighted average using the group sizes, found from the total sums of both groups divided by the total count.
concepts.explanation_hi: Do groups ka mila hua ausat unke ausat ka seedha aadha nahi hota, har group ke kul jod ko jod kar kul ginti se bhag do.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Average after inclusion, exclusion or replacement
concepts.definition_en: When a member joins, leaves or is replaced in a group, the new average follows from the change in the total: add the new member's value and subtract the removed member's value, then divide by the new count, which also gives the shortcut that the average shifts by the total change divided by the count.
concepts.explanation_hi: Group me koi aaye, jaaye ya badle to naya ausat kul jod ke badlav se nikalo, naye ko jodo aur gaye ko ghatao, phir nayi ginti se bhag do.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Average of consecutive and AP series
concepts.definition_en: The average of consecutive numbers, or of any arithmetic progression, is the middle term when the count is odd, or the average of the two middle terms when the count is even, which equals (first term + last term)/2.
concepts.explanation_hi: Lagatar numbers ya AP series ka ausat beech wala number hota hai, jo pehle aur aakhri number ke jod ka aadha bhi hota hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE (Delhi Police HC: PROVISIONAL)

concepts.name: Ages n years ago or hence
concepts.definition_en: If a person's present age is x, then n years ago it was x - n and n years hence it will be x + n; the same shift applies to every person in the problem.
concepts.explanation_hi: Present age se peeche jaana ho to minus karo, aage jaana ho to plus karo, sabki age ek saath badalti hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Age ratios
concepts.definition_en: Ages of two people are expressed as a ratio a:b, so their ages can be written as ax and bx and solved from a given sum, difference, or age after or before n years.
concepts.explanation_hi: Age ka ratio matlab dono ki age ko ek hi x se likh do, phir di gayi shart se x nikaal lo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Father-son type problems
concepts.definition_en: In father-son (or mother-daughter) problems the difference between the two ages stays constant over time, while their ratio changes as both ages shift by the same number of years.
concepts.explanation_hi: Baap-bete ki age ka farq hamesha same rehta hai, ratio badalta hai kyunki dono ki age barabar badhti hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Sum of ages
concepts.definition_en: The sum of the ages of a group is the total obtained by adding each person's age, and individual ages can be recovered from the sum together with a ratio or a difference condition.
concepts.explanation_hi: Sabki age jod do to sum mil jaata hai, aur sum ke saath ratio ya farq diya ho to ek-ek ki age nikal jaati hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Average age of a group
concepts.definition_en: The average age of a group is the sum of all members' ages divided by the number of members; adding or removing a person changes the total by that person's age.
concepts.explanation_hi: Group ki average age matlab sabki age ka jod, divided by logon ki sankhya.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: CP, SP and MP relations
concepts.definition_en: Cost price (CP) is what the seller paid, selling price (SP) is what the buyer paid, and marked price (MP) is the price printed on the article; profit occurs when SP exceeds CP and loss when CP exceeds SP.
concepts.explanation_hi: CP matlab khareed daam, SP matlab bechne ka daam, MP matlab tag par likha daam.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: CP from two sale prices
concepts.definition_en: When the same article sold at two different prices gives a known profit in one case and a known loss (or different profit) in the other, the cost price is found by equating the two expressions for CP.
concepts.explanation_hi: Ek hi cheez do daamon par bechi ho to dono sale price se CP ka ek hi jawab aana chahiye, usi se CP nikaalo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Profit and loss percent
concepts.definition_en: Profit or loss percent is always calculated on the cost price unless stated otherwise: profit percent equals profit divided by CP times 100, and loss percent equals loss divided by CP times 100.
concepts.explanation_hi: Profit ya loss percent hamesha CP par nikalta hai, SP par nahi, yahi sabse bada trap hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Profit on cost vs on selling price
concepts.definition_en: Profit expressed on cost price and profit expressed on selling price use different bases, so the same money profit gives different percentages; converting between them requires changing the base from CP to SP or vice versa.
concepts.explanation_hi: CP par profit aur SP par profit alag hota hai kyunki base alag hai, isliye percent seedha copy-paste nahi hota.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Selling at two prices
concepts.definition_en: When an article is sold first at one price and then at another, the net result is found by comparing each selling price with the cost price, or by comparing the two selling prices when the profit or loss on one of them is known.
concepts.explanation_hi: Ek cheez ko do alag daamon par bechna matlab dono SP ko CP se compare karo, tabhi asli fayda-nuksaan pata chalega.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Gain or loss on selling a batch
concepts.definition_en: When a batch of articles is bought and sold, total cost price and total selling price are used: overall profit or loss percent is computed on the total CP, not by averaging the per-article percentages unless quantities are equal.
concepts.explanation_hi: Poori batch ka hisaab total CP aur total SP se karo, ek-ek article ka percent average karke nahi.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Dishonest weights
concepts.definition_en: A dishonest dealer who claims to sell at cost price but uses a false weight actually sells less quantity for the price of the full quantity, so the gain percent is the shortfall divided by the quantity actually given, times 100.
concepts.explanation_hi: Beimaan dukaan wala 1 kg bolkar kam tolta hai, to fayda us kami par nikalta hai jo usne kam diya.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Discount percent on MP
concepts.definition_en: Discount is the reduction from the marked price, and discount percent is always calculated on the marked price: SP equals MP minus discount.
concepts.explanation_hi: Discount hamesha MP par nikalta hai, SP par nahi, aur SP matlab MP minus discount.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Single equivalent of successive discounts
concepts.definition_en: Two successive discounts of a% and b% do not add up to (a + b)%, because the second discount applies to the already reduced price; the single equivalent discount is a + b - (a x b / 100).
concepts.explanation_hi: Do discount ek ke baad ek lagte hain, isliye seedha jodna galat hai, doosra discount ghate hue daam par lagta hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: MP from SP and discount
concepts.definition_en: When selling price and discount percent are known, the marked price is recovered by reversing the discount: MP equals SP divided by (1 - discount percent/100).
concepts.explanation_hi: SP aur discount percent diya ho to ulta chal kar MP nikaalo, SP ko discount wale factor se divide karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Discount and profit combined
concepts.definition_en: When an article is marked up on cost price and then sold at a discount, the final profit or loss is found by chaining the two steps: MP from CP by the mark-up, then SP from MP by the discount, then comparing SP with CP.
concepts.explanation_hi: Pehle CP par mark-up lagakar MP banao, phir MP par discount lagakar SP banao, tab CP se compare karke profit-loss dekho.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: SI formula
concepts.definition_en: Simple interest is interest calculated only on the original principal for the whole period, and the amount is principal plus interest.
concepts.explanation_hi: Simple interest matlab sirf asli principal par interest, har saal ek jaisa interest milta hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Interest on a sum split at two rates
concepts.definition_en: When a sum is split into two parts lent at different rates for the same time, total simple interest is the sum of the interest on each part, and the parts can be recovered from the total interest.
concepts.explanation_hi: Rakam ko do hisson mein baant kar alag-alag rate par lagao to total interest dono hisson ke interest ka jod hota hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Finding P, R or T
concepts.definition_en: Any one of principal, rate, or time can be found from the other three quantities and the simple interest by rearranging SI = PRT/100.
concepts.explanation_hi: SI ka formula ulta karke P, R ya T mein se jo chhupa ho use nikaal lo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: SI instalment
concepts.definition_en: When a debt under simple interest is repaid in equal annual instalments, each instalment covers the principal part plus the interest on the amount still outstanding, so the instalment is found from the total amount due spread over the instalment years with interest adjustment.
concepts.explanation_hi: Kist matlab har saal barabar rakam dena, jisme principal ke saath bacha hua interest bhi shamil hota hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Difference between two SI schemes
concepts.definition_en: The difference between simple interest under two rates, times, or principals is the difference of the two SI values computed separately, and it can be used to recover an unknown principal or rate.
concepts.explanation_hi: Do alag rate ya time ke SI ka farq nikaalo, wahi farq aksar principal ya rate dhoondhne ka raasta deta hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: CI amount formula
concepts.definition_en: Compound interest is interest on the principal plus all previously accumulated interest, so the amount after n years is P times (1 + r/100) raised to the power n, and CI is amount minus principal.
concepts.explanation_hi: Compound interest mein interest par bhi interest lagta hai, isliye rakam har saal badhte hue base par badhti hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS (SI only per MTS syllabus; CI flagged UNVERIFIED for MTS)

concepts.name: Half-yearly and quarterly compounding
concepts.definition_en: When interest compounds half-yearly, the rate is halved and the number of periods doubled; when it compounds quarterly, the rate is divided by four and the number of periods multiplied by four.
concepts.explanation_hi: Half-yearly matlab rate aadha aur time double, quarterly matlab rate ek-chauthai aur time chaar guna.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS (SI only per MTS syllabus; CI flagged UNVERIFIED for MTS)

concepts.name: SI-CI difference (2-year and 3-year rules)
concepts.definition_en: For the same principal and rate, CI exceeds SI from the second year onwards because interest itself earns interest; for 2 years the difference equals P times (r/100) squared, and for 3 years it follows the standard 3-year difference formula.
concepts.explanation_hi: SI aur CI ka farq pehle saal zero hota hai, doosre saal se CI aage nikal jaata hai kyunki interest par interest lagta hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS (SI only per MTS syllabus; CI flagged UNVERIFIED for MTS)

concepts.name: CI instalments
concepts.definition_en: When a loan under compound interest is repaid in equal instalments, each instalment is the present value of the remaining debt discounted at the compound rate, so the instalment is found by equating the principal to the sum of the discounted instalments.
concepts.explanation_hi: CI wali kist mein har kist ko compound rate se discount karke jodo, wahi jod principal ke barabar hota hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS (SI only per MTS syllabus; CI flagged UNVERIFIED for MTS); instalment depth is level-dependent for GD Constable, Selection Post (Matric/10+2 level), MI Translator and Paramedical

concepts.name: Population and value growth
concepts.definition_en: Growth of population or value at a fixed percent per year follows the compound interest amount formula, with the growth rate in place of the interest rate.
concepts.explanation_hi: Abaadi ya keemat har saal ek fixed percent se badhe to wahi CI wala formula lagta hai, bas rate growth ka hota hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS (SI only per MTS syllabus; CI flagged UNVERIFIED for MTS)

concepts.name: Depreciation
concepts.definition_en: Depreciation is the fall in value of an asset at a fixed percent per year, calculated by the compound decay formula in which the value is multiplied by (1 - rate/100) each year.
concepts.explanation_hi: Depreciation matlab keemat har saal ek fixed percent se ghatna, isliye multiply karte waqt minus wala factor lagta hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS (SI only per MTS syllabus; CI flagged UNVERIFIED for MTS)

concepts.name: Speed equals distance over time
concepts.definition_en: Speed is distance covered per unit time, so distance equals speed times time and time equals distance divided by speed, with all three quantities in consistent units.
concepts.explanation_hi: Speed matlab ek unit time mein kitni doori, isliye doori nikaalni ho to speed ko time se guna karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Unit conversion km/h to m/s
concepts.definition_en: Speeds in km/h are converted to m/s by multiplying by 5/18, and speeds in m/s are converted to km/h by multiplying by 18/5.
concepts.explanation_hi: km/h ko m/s banana ho to 5/18 se guna karo, ulta karna ho to 18/5 se guna karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Relative speed
concepts.definition_en: When two bodies move in the same direction their relative speed is the difference of their speeds, and when they move in opposite directions it is the sum of their speeds.
concepts.explanation_hi: Ek hi disha mein ja rahe hon to speed ka farq dekho, aamne-saamne aa rahe hon to speed ka jod dekho.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Average speed over legs
concepts.definition_en: Average speed over a journey is total distance divided by total time, not the simple average of the speeds, and for equal distances at two speeds it equals twice the product divided by the sum of the speeds.
concepts.explanation_hi: Average speed matlab total doori divided by total time, dono speed ka seedha average lena galat hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Early and late arrival
concepts.definition_en: When the same distance travelled at two speeds gives an early arrival in one case and a late arrival in the other, the difference between the two travel times equals the sum of the early and late minutes, from which the distance or the usual time is recovered.
concepts.explanation_hi: Ek speed se jaldi pahuncho aur doosri se late, to dono time ka farq early plus late ke barabar hota hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Circular track meeting points
concepts.definition_en: On a circular track, two runners meet when their relative distance covered equals the track length (same direction) or a multiple of it, and the first meeting time is the track length divided by the relative speed.
concepts.explanation_hi: Gol track par milna matlab ek ne doosre se poora ek chakkar zyada ya kam daud liya ho.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE-except: MTS, GD Constable, Selection Post (Matric/10+2 level), MI Translator, Paramedical — circular-track depth is unverified at those levels

concepts.name: Train crossing a pole or man
concepts.definition_en: When a train crosses a pole, man, or any point object, the distance covered equals the train's own length, so time equals train length divided by speed.
concepts.explanation_hi: Train jab khambe ya aadmi ko paar kare to sirf train ki lambai hi doori hoti hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Train crossing a platform, bridge or tunnel
concepts.definition_en: When a train crosses a platform, bridge, or tunnel, the distance covered equals the train's length plus the length of the platform, bridge, or tunnel.
concepts.explanation_hi: Platform ya pul paar karna ho to train ki lambai mein platform ki lambai bhi jod do.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Two trains in same or opposite direction
concepts.definition_en: Two trains moving in the same direction approach each other at the difference of their speeds, and in opposite directions at the sum of their speeds; this relative speed governs their meeting and crossing times.
concepts.explanation_hi: Do train ek disha mein hon to speed ka farq, vipreet disha mein hon to speed ka jod hi relative speed hoti hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Train crossing another train
concepts.definition_en: When one train crosses another, the distance covered equals the sum of the two trains' lengths, and the crossing time is that total length divided by their relative speed.
concepts.explanation_hi: Ek train doosri ko paar kare to dono train ki lambai jod do, phir relative speed se divide karo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Upstream and downstream speeds
concepts.definition_en: Upstream speed is the boat's speed in still water minus the stream's speed, and downstream speed is the boat's speed in still water plus the stream's speed.
concepts.explanation_hi: Dhara ke khilaaf jaana upstream hai jisme speed ghat jaati hai, dhara ke saath jaana downstream hai jisme speed badh jaati hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Time ratio upstream vs downstream
concepts.definition_en: For the same distance, time taken upstream and downstream are in the inverse ratio of the upstream and downstream speeds.
concepts.explanation_hi: Ek hi doori ke liye time speed ke ulte ratio mein hota hai, jis disha mein speed kam usme time zyada.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Finding boat and stream speed from two trips
concepts.definition_en: If upstream and downstream speeds are known, the boat's speed in still water is their average and the stream's speed is half their difference.
concepts.explanation_hi: Upstream aur downstream speed pata ho to boat ki speed dono ka average hoti hai, dhara ki speed dono ke farq ka aadha.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Round-trip average speed
concepts.definition_en: For a round trip over the same distance upstream and downstream, the average speed is total distance divided by total time, which equals twice the product of the upstream and downstream speeds divided by their sum.
concepts.explanation_hi: Aana-jaana ek hi doori ka ho to round-trip average speed dono speed ke product ka double divided by unka jod hoti hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Work equals efficiency times time
concepts.definition_en: Work done equals a worker's efficiency (work per unit time) multiplied by time taken, so a worker who finishes a job in n days does 1/n of the job per day.
concepts.explanation_hi: Kaam matlab ek din mein kitna kaam, guna time, aur n din mein poora kaam karne wala ek din mein 1/n kaam karta hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Combined efficiency
concepts.definition_en: When workers work together, their efficiencies add up, so their combined one-day work is the sum of their individual one-day works.
concepts.explanation_hi: Saath kaam karein to sabki ek din ki capacity jod do, wahi combined efficiency hoti hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: A, B and C working together
concepts.definition_en: The time taken by A, B and C together is the reciprocal of their combined one-day work, found by adding their individual efficiencies.
concepts.explanation_hi: A, B, C saath kaam karein to pehle combined one-day work nikaalo, phir uska ulta hi total time hoga.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Work left and work finished
concepts.definition_en: Work finished in n days is n times the one-day work, and work left is the total work minus the work finished, from which the remaining time is found.
concepts.explanation_hi: Kitna kaam ho gaya ye n din guna ek din ka kaam hai, baaki kaam matlab total minus ho gaya kaam.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Wages proportional to efficiency
concepts.definition_en: When workers work for the same time, wages are shared in proportion to their efficiencies (their one-day works), and when times differ, wages are shared in proportion to work actually done.
concepts.explanation_hi: Majdoori efficiency ke hisaab se banti hai, jo zyada kaam karta hai use utna hi zyada hissa milta hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Alternate-day working
concepts.definition_en: When workers work on alternate days, work done in each two-day cycle is the sum of their one-day works, and the total days are counted cycle by cycle with care for the final partial cycle.
concepts.explanation_hi: Ek din ek, doosre din doosra kaam kare to har do din ka kaam dono ke ek din ke kaam ka jod hota hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Men-women work equivalence
concepts.definition_en: Men-women (or men-women-children) work problems equate total work across groups using man-days: the product of number of workers, days, and hours is constant for the same work, adjusted for differing efficiencies.
concepts.explanation_hi: Aadmi-aurat wale sawaal mein total kaam ko man-days se barabar karo, workers guna din guna ghante same kaam ke liye same hota hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Filling and emptying rates
concepts.definition_en: A pipe that fills a cistern in n hours fills 1/n of it per hour, and a pipe that empties it in m hours empties 1/m per hour; these rates are the pipe equivalents of work efficiency.
concepts.explanation_hi: Nal n ghante mein tank bhare to ek ghante mein 1/n bharta hai, khaali karne wala nal bhi waise hi 1/m khaali karta hai.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Cistern capacity
concepts.definition_en: Cistern capacity is the total volume to be filled, found as filling rate multiplied by time to fill, or recovered from the combined rates and the time taken when pipes work together.
concepts.explanation_hi: Tank ki capacity matlab rate guna time, ya saare nalon ke combined rate se time nikaal kar capacity dhoondhna.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Net rate with a leak
concepts.definition_en: A leak acts as a negative filling rate, so the net filling rate is the filling rate minus the leak rate, and the time to fill lengthens accordingly.
concepts.explanation_hi: Leak matlab tank se paani nikal raha hai, isliye net rate mein leak ki rate minus kar do.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Pipes opened together
concepts.definition_en: When pipes are opened together, their rates add (filling rates positive, emptying rates negative), and the time to fill or empty is the reciprocal of the net rate.
concepts.explanation_hi: Saare nal ek saath kholo to bharne wale ki rate jodo aur khaali karne wale ki rate ghatao, phir ulta karke time nikaalo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Time to fill with one pipe closed
concepts.definition_en: When one pipe is closed partway or works only for a period, the cistern is filled in two phases: the combined rate applies while all pipes are open, and the remaining part is filled at the rate of the pipes still open.
concepts.explanation_hi: Ek nal beech mein band ho jaaye to pehle sabke saath ka hissa, phir baaki nalon se baaki hissa alag-alag nikaalo.
concepts.exam_mapping: CORE

concepts.name: Square of a binomial (a±b)^2
concepts.definition_en: The square of a binomial expands to the sum of the squares of the two terms plus or minus twice their product. It is the most used algebraic identity in SSC questions.
concepts.explanation_hi: Do terms ka square matlab dono ke square plus/minus 2ab, bas yahi formula har jagah kaam aata hai.

concepts.name: Cube of a binomial (a±b)^3
concepts.definition_en: The cube of a binomial expands to the cubes of the two terms plus or minus three times the product of one term squared with the other term. It is used to evaluate cubes and to reverse-expand cubic expressions.
concepts.explanation_hi: Cube kholne par dono ke cube ke saath 3a^2b aur 3ab^2 wale terms bhi aate hain, sign plus/minus ke hisaab se.

concepts.name: Difference of squares a^2 - b^2
concepts.definition_en: The difference of two squares factorises as the product of the sum and the difference of the two terms. It is used both for factorisation and for fast evaluation of expressions.
concepts.explanation_hi: Do squares ka antar seedha (a+b)(a-b) ban jaata hai, isse factor bhi banta hai aur calculation bhi fast hoti hai.

concepts.name: Sum and difference of cubes a^3 ± b^3
concepts.definition_en: The sum of two cubes factorises as (a+b)(a^2 - ab + b^2) and the difference of two cubes as (a-b)(a^2 + ab + b^2). These identities connect cubic expressions with linear and quadratic factors.
concepts.explanation_hi: Cubes ka jod ya antar ek linear factor aur ek quadratic factor mein toot jaata hai, beech wale term ka sign ulta hota hai.

concepts.name: Factorisation of polynomials
concepts.definition_en: Factorisation writes a polynomial as a product of simpler factors by taking out common factors, grouping terms, or applying algebraic identities. A factorised form makes roots and cancellations visible.
concepts.explanation_hi: Factorisation matlab bade expression ko chhote factors ke gunank mein todna, common nikaal kar ya identity laga kar.

concepts.name: Solving linear equations in one variable
concepts.definition_en: A linear equation in one variable is solved by applying the same operation to both sides until the variable is isolated. Its graph is a straight line and it has exactly one solution unless it is an identity or a contradiction.
concepts.explanation_hi: Ek variable wali linear equation mein dono taraf ek jaisa operation karke variable ko akela kar do, answer mil jaayega.

concepts.name: Roots of quadratic equations
concepts.definition_en: The roots of ax^2 + bx + c = 0 are the values of x that satisfy it, found by factorisation or the quadratic formula. The discriminant b^2 - 4ac decides whether the roots are real and distinct, real and equal, or non-real.
concepts.explanation_hi: Quadratic ke roots matlab woh x values jo equation ko zero karein, discriminant se pata chalta hai roots real hain ya nahi.

concepts.explanation_hi: Surd wale expression mein root ko rationalise karke aur same surd wale terms ko jod kar simplify karte hain.

concepts.explanation_hi: Quadratic ka sabse chhota ya bada value x = -b/2a par milta hai, a positive ho to minimum aur negative ho to maximum.

concepts.name: Algebraic inequalities
concepts.definition_en: An inequality compares two expressions with <, >, <= or >=, and its solution is the set of values that make the comparison true. Multiplying or dividing by a negative number reverses the inequality sign.
concepts.explanation_hi: Inequality mein sign ka dhyaan rakho, negative se guna ya bhaag karne par sign ulta ho jaata hai, baaki equation jaisa hi solve hota hai.

concepts.name: Logarithms: definition and laws
concepts.definition_en: The logarithm log_a(x) is the exponent to which the base a must be raised to get x, defined for a > 0, a not 1, and x > 0. Its laws turn multiplication into addition, division into subtraction, and powers into multiplication by the exponent.
concepts.explanation_hi: Log matlab woh power jo base par chadhane se number mile, aur iske laws se guna bhaag jod ghat mein badal jaata hai.

concepts.name: Binomial theorem expansion
concepts.definition_en: The binomial theorem expands (a+b)^n as a sum of terms of the form C(n,r) a^(n-r) b^r for r = 0 to n. The general term gives any single term of the expansion without writing the whole expansion.
concepts.explanation_hi: (a+b)^n kholne par har term mein combination coefficient ke saath a aur b ki powers hoti hain, general term se koi bhi ek term seedha mil jaata hai.

concepts.definition_en: Angles on a straight line add to 180 degrees, angles around a point add to 360 degrees, and vertically opposite angles are equal. Adjacent angles on a line form a linear pair.
concepts.explanation_hi: Seedhi line par angles 180, ek point ke chaaron taraf 360, aur aamne-saamne wale angles barabar hote hain.

concepts.explanation_hi: Parallel lines ko transversal kaate to corresponding aur alternate angles barabar, aur ek taraf wale co-interior angles ka jod 180 hota hai.

concepts.name: Triangle angle sum and exterior angle
concepts.definition_en: The three interior angles of a triangle add to 180 degrees, and an exterior angle equals the sum of the two opposite interior angles. These two facts solve most triangle angle questions.
concepts.explanation_hi: Triangle ke teeno angles ka jod 180 hota hai, aur bahar wala angle andar ke do opposite angles ke jod ke barabar hota hai.

concepts.name: Pythagoras theorem
concepts.definition_en: In a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides. It is used to find an unknown side and to test whether a triangle is right-angled.
concepts.explanation_hi: Samkon triangle mein sabse badi side ka square baaki dono sides ke squares ke jod ke barabar hota hai.

concepts.definition_en: Two triangles are congruent when they match exactly under SSS (three sides), SAS (two sides and the included angle), ASA (two angles and the included side), or RHS (right angle, hypotenuse, one side). Congruent triangles have equal corresponding sides and angles.
concepts.explanation_hi: Do triangle tabhi congruent hote hain jab SSS, SAS, ASA ya RHS mein se koi ek condition poori ho, phir unke saare parts barabar hote hain.

concepts.name: Triangle area and perimeter
concepts.definition_en: The perimeter of a triangle is the sum of its three sides, and its area is half the product of a base and its corresponding height. When only the three sides are known, Heron's formula gives the area from the semi-perimeter.
concepts.explanation_hi: Triangle ka perimeter teeno sides ka jod aur area aadha base guna height hota hai, sirf sides hon to Heron se nikaalte hain.

concepts.name: Square area and perimeter
concepts.definition_en: A square with side a has perimeter 4a and area a^2, and its diagonal is a times sqrt(2). Both results follow directly from the equal sides and right angles.
concepts.explanation_hi: Square mein side a ho to perimeter 4a, area a square, aur diagonal a root 2 hoti hai.

concepts.name: Rectangle area and perimeter
concepts.definition_en: A rectangle with length l and breadth b has perimeter 2(l + b) and area l x b, and its diagonal is sqrt(l^2 + b^2) by Pythagoras theorem. It is the standard shape for flooring and fencing problems.
concepts.explanation_hi: Rectangle mein perimeter 2(l+b), area l guna b, aur diagonal Pythagoras se root(l square + b square) hoti hai.

concepts.name: Parallelogram area and perimeter
concepts.definition_en: A parallelogram with base b and height h has area b x h, where height is the perpendicular distance between the bases, not the slant side. Its perimeter is twice the sum of adjacent sides.
concepts.explanation_hi: Parallelogram ka area base guna height hota hai, height slant side nahi balki dono bases ke beech ki seedhi doori hoti hai.

concepts.name: Trapezium area and perimeter
concepts.definition_en: A trapezium with parallel sides a and b and height h (the distance between them) has area (1/2)(a + b)h. Its perimeter is the sum of all four sides, with non-parallel sides found separately if needed.
concepts.explanation_hi: Trapezium ka area aadha (parallel sides ka jod) guna unke beech ki height hota hai, perimeter chaaro sides ka jod hota hai.

concepts.name: Rhombus area and perimeter
concepts.definition_en: A rhombus with side a has perimeter 4a, and its area is half the product of its two diagonals. Its diagonals bisect each other at right angles, which also gives the side from the diagonals by Pythagoras theorem.
concepts.explanation_hi: Rhombus ka perimeter 4a aur area dono diagonals ke gunank ka aadha hota hai, diagonals ek doosre ko 90 degree par aadha kaat ti hain.

concepts.name: Circle area and circumference
concepts.definition_en: A circle of radius r has circumference 2 x pi x r and area pi x r^2, and its diameter is 2r. These two formulas are the base for sector, segment and ring problems.
concepts.explanation_hi: Circle mein radius r ho to circumference 2 pi r aur area pi r square hota hai, diameter radius ka dugna hota hai.

concepts.name: Sector of a circle
concepts.definition_en: A sector is the region bounded by two radii and an arc, and for central angle theta in degrees its area is (theta/360) times the full circle area and its arc length is (theta/360) times the circumference. A quadrant and a semicircle are sectors of 90 and 180 degrees.
concepts.explanation_hi: Sector matlab do radius aur arc se ghira hissa, uska area aur arc length poore circle ka theta/360 hissa hota hai.

concepts.name: Segment of a circle
concepts.definition_en: A segment is the region between a chord and its arc, and its area is the sector area minus the area of the triangle formed by the two radii and the chord (for a minor segment). It therefore combines a sector calculation with a triangle calculation.
concepts.explanation_hi: Segment matlab chord aur arc ke beech ka hissa, iska area sector area mein se radii wale triangle ka area ghata kar milta hai.

concepts.name: Ring (annulus) area
concepts.definition_en: A ring is the region between two concentric circles, and its area is the difference of the two circle areas, pi(R^2 - r^2), where R is the outer radius and r is the inner radius. It is used for circular paths and washers.
concepts.explanation_hi: Ring matlab do concentric circles ke beech ka hissa, iska area bade circle mein se chhota circle ghata kar milta hai.

concepts.name: Area of paths and borders
concepts.definition_en: The area of a path or border around a shape is the area of the outer shape minus the area of the inner shape, with the path width added on all sides for an outer path. For a path inside, the inner dimensions are reduced by the width on each side.
concepts.explanation_hi: Path ya border ka area bahar wale shape mein se andar wala ghata kar milta hai, bahar wale path mein width dono taraf judti hai.

concepts.name: Cost of flooring and fencing
concepts.definition_en: Flooring cost is the area to be covered multiplied by the rate per unit area, and fencing cost is the perimeter multiplied by the rate per unit length. The geometry step (area or perimeter) comes first and the cost step second.
concepts.explanation_hi: Flooring ka kharcha area guna rate hota hai aur fencing ka kharcha perimeter guna rate, pehle area/perimeter nikaalo phir rate se guna karo.

concepts.name: Melting and recasting
concepts.definition_en: When a solid is melted and recast into smaller solids, total volume is conserved, so the number of small solids is the big volume divided by one small volume (when shapes are fully filled). Surface area is not conserved.
concepts.explanation_hi: Pighla kar dobara dhalne par volume same rehta hai, isliye chhote solids ki sankhya bada volume bhaag chhota volume se milti hai, surface area same nahi rehta.

concepts.definition_en: In a right triangle, sin is opposite over hypotenuse, cos is adjacent over hypotenuse, and tan is opposite over adjacent, with sec, cosec and cot as their reciprocals. All six ratios are defined from the same three sides.
concepts.explanation_hi: Samkon triangle mein sin opposite/hypotenuse, cos adjacent/hypotenuse, tan opposite/adjacent hota hai, aur sec cosec cot inke ulte hote hain.

concepts.name: Fundamental trigonometric identities
concepts.definition_en: The Pythagorean identities sin^2 + cos^2 = 1, sec^2 - tan^2 = 1 and cosec^2 - cot^2 = 1 hold for all valid angles, together with tan = sin/cos and cot = cos/sin. They are used to convert an expression into a single ratio or a number.
concepts.explanation_hi: sin square + cos square = 1, sec square - tan square = 1 jaise identities har valid angle par chalti hain, inhi se expression simplify hota hai.

concepts.name: Distance formula
concepts.definition_en: The distance between two points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) is sqrt((x2 - x1)^2 + (y2 - y1)^2), which is Pythagoras theorem applied to the horizontal and vertical differences. It also gives the distance of a point from the origin.
concepts.explanation_hi: Do points ke beech ki doori Pythagoras se milti hai, x ka antar aur y ka antar square karke jod do phir root lo.

concepts.name: Section formula internal division
concepts.definition_en: A point dividing the segment joining (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) internally in ratio m:n has coordinates ((m x2 + n x1)/(m + n), (m y2 + n y1)/(m + n)). It is a weighted average of the endpoints, weighted toward the farther endpoint's opposite ratio part.
concepts.explanation_hi: Internal division mein point ke coordinates endpoints ka weighted average hote hain, ratio m:n mein point ko us hisaab se baanta jaata hai.

concepts.name: Section formula external division
concepts.definition_en: A point dividing the segment joining (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) externally in ratio m:n lies outside the segment, with coordinates ((m x2 - n x1)/(m - n), (m y2 - n y1)/(m - n)) for m not equal to n. The only change from internal division is the minus signs.
concepts.explanation_hi: External division mein point segment ke bahar hota hai, formula internal jaisa hi hai bas minus sign ke saath.

concepts.name: Midpoint formula
concepts.definition_en: The midpoint of the segment joining (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) is the average of the coordinates, ((x1 + x2)/2, (y1 + y2)/2). It is the section formula with ratio 1:1.
concepts.explanation_hi: Midpoint matlab dono points ke coordinates ka average, x ka average aur y ka average alag alag lo.

concepts.name: Slope of a line
concepts.definition_en: The slope of the line through (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) is (y2 - y1)/(x2 - x1), the vertical change divided by the horizontal change. Parallel lines have equal slopes, and perpendicular lines have slopes whose product is -1.
concepts.explanation_hi: Slope matlab y ka badlaav bhaag x ka badlaav, parallel lines ka slope barabar aur perpendicular ka guna -1 hota hai.

concepts.name: Equation of a line
concepts.definition_en: A line with slope m passing through (x1, y1) has equation y - y1 = m(x - x1), and the general form is ax + by + c = 0. The slope-intercept form y = mx + c reads the slope and the y-intercept directly.
concepts.explanation_hi: Line ki equation slope aur ek point se banti hai, y = mx + c mein m slope aur c y-intercept seedha dikhta hai.

concepts.name: Area of a triangle from coordinates
concepts.definition_en: The area of a triangle with vertices (x1, y1), (x2, y2) and (x3, y3) is half the absolute value of x1(y2 - y3) + x2(y3 - y1) + x3(y1 - y2). The absolute value is taken because area is always positive.
concepts.explanation_hi: Coordinates se triangle ka area us shoelace wale formula se milta hai, answer ka absolute value lo kyunki area kabhi negative nahi hota.

concepts.name: Centroid from coordinates
concepts.definition_en: The centroid of a triangle with vertices (x1, y1), (x2, y2) and (x3, y3) is the average of the vertices, ((x1 + x2 + x3)/3, (y1 + y2 + y3)/3). It matches the geometry centroid where the medians meet.
concepts.explanation_hi: Coordinates se centroid teeno vertices ka average hota hai, x ka average aur y ka average alag alag nikaalo.

concepts.name: Collinearity test for three points
concepts.definition_en: Three points are collinear when they lie on one straight line, tested either by equal slopes between pairs of points or by zero area of the triangle they form. Either test is sufficient.
concepts.explanation_hi: Teen points tabhi collinear hote hain jab woh ek hi line par hon, isko slope barabar se ya triangle area zero se check karte hain.
